ns2:course.label: Parallel Computer Architecture
ns2:course.description: Theoretical aspects of parallel and pipeline computation; time and processor bounds on classes of computations; data alignment network speed and cost bounds; conflict-free access memories; overall computer system ideas. Same as CSE 522. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CS 433 or CSE 422.
